Load plugin capability summaries and feed them into the composer; plugin mentions appear alongside skills and apps. - Generalize mention parsing to a sigil parameter, still defaults to `$` Builds on #13510. Currently clients have to build their own `id` via `plugin@marketplace` and filter plugins to show by `enabled`, but we will add `id` and `available` as fields returned from `plugin/list` soon. ####Tests Added tests, verified locally.
